title: Senior Software Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Relay is a digital banking platform that gives self-made business owners the tools and know-how to be great with money—bringing clarity, confidence, and control to every dollar earned, so they can turn hard work into lasting success. We do this by replacing financial guesswork with real visibility, transforming cash flow from a constant source of stress into a clear signal owners can use to run stronger, more resilient businesses.

You'll join Core Banking, the team building the resilient banking infrastructure that Relay's customers and internal teams depend on — ACH and wire transfers, local and international, and everything that keeps money moving securely and predictably. Core and Risk Engineering are tied at the hip, and you'll be embedded across both. The team's north star is simple: scalable, reliable, on time, under budget — measured in escaped defects, test flakiness and duration, incident count, and uptime.

Your mission is to scale quality operations and build the tooling, frameworks and CI pipelines for a distributed system that make it easy to scale quality and increase development velocity across every engineering team at Relay.

This is not a role where you write UI tests against someone else's system. You will have the same leverage as a developer.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the quality roadmap for Risk Engineering and build the quality engineering frameworks for Core Banking systems, including ACH and domestic and international wire transfers.

  • Build and improve our CI infrastructure, including the migration to ministack — testing lambdas and microservices in CI with local implementations of Wiremock, Localstack and PSQL. You'll be measured on the same numbers the team is: escaped defects, test flakiness and duration, incident count, uptime.

  • Drive shift-left across the teams you're embedded in — attending sprint ceremonies and getting developers writing tests as part of their deliverables, not as a handoff to QA.

  • Find and remove the bottlenecks in quality operations, diagnosing pain points across Core Banking and Risk and championing the solutions.

  • Build tools that improve developer experience, with minimal dependency on third parties.

  • Mentor junior quality engineers and contribute to the direction and larger-scale initiatives of the Quality Engineering team.

  • Tell the quality story with data — gathering defect and quality data from across our systems and presenting it to engineering leadership and executives.

Roughly 75% of your week is hands-on building. The other 25% is influence: ceremonies, mentorship, evangelism, and getting teams to adopt what you've built.

Who You Are

  • You have built quality engineering systems from the ground up, hands on — frameworks, test suites and CI systems, not just tests written against someone else's harness.

  • You have tested distributed systems, not only UIs. Services, lambdas, microservices, real-time applications — you understand what makes them hard to test and you've done it in CI.

  • You understand and care deeply about system architecture - you have an in depth understanding of how a distributed system is architected - how systems communicate, how scaleability and resilience is built into a system and how to design tests for these complex systems instead of treating them like a black box.

  • You can influence and persuade development teams to adopt quality practices. You've changed how a team works, not just what you shipped.

  • You debug from first principles, using code, logs and traces to get to genuine root cause.

  • You can gather quality and defect data from multiple sources and present it to a wide audience, including executives, and make the numbers mean something.

  • You are AI-fluent in practice — using AI tools daily, comfortable with how agents work and with the systems underneath them, and able to critique AI output rather than accept it blindly.

  • You thrive in agile teams that move quickly and you're comfortable with ambiguity and abstract requirements.

Bonus Points

  • Mobile testing experience (Detox).

  • Experience with AWS systems.

Our stack: React, Nodejs, AWS Infrastructure (Queues, S3, DynamoDB etc.) , PSQL, Redis, Playwright, Detox, GitHub Actions, Ministack/Localstack, Wiremock, Bruno, Sentry, Datadog, Cursor, Claude, JIRA, Notion.

The Interview Process

  • Stage 1: A 30-minute Google Meet video call with a member of our Engineering Team

  • Stage 2: A 60-minute Google Meet with the Hiring Manager

  • Stage 3: A 90-minute technical interview and case study with members of the hiring team

  • Stage 4: A 45-minute Google Meet video call with a member of our leadership team

Our Compensation Approach

We believe Relayers should feel rewarded for the impact they have on our mission and growth. Compensation follows impact. As impact increases, compensation grows, and we do not limit compensation changes to a once-a-year review cycle.

The annual salary range for this role is $157,500 CAD to $192,500 CAD.

For candidates who demonstrate full readiness for the defined scope of the role, the typical starting salary is $175,000 CAD. Offers below this point reflect candidates we believe can grow into the full scope of the role with support and development. Offers above this point reflect impact that meaningfully exceeds the role’s defined expectations or an expanded scope from day one.

We encourage you to have a conversation with your recruiter and ask questions about compensation throughout the hiring process. For more information on our compensation philosophy and perks and benefits, visit our Candidate Hub.

Why Relay Might Be the Perfect Fit For You

  • You push relentlessly for reinvention: You're always asking "how can this be better?" -- in your work, in your craft, in yourself. Comfort is a signal to push harder, not coast. You'd rather build something better than defend something familiar.

  • You crave autonomy: We trust our team with big challenges and the freedom to solve them. If you’re someone who takes initiative, is comfortable taking risks, and seeks input when needed, you’ll find the freedom here empowering.

  • You own your work: You take pride in your work, follow through on commitments, and feel a deep sense of responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

  • You build with AI, not just use it: You're actively embedding AI into how you work, pushing what's possible, and bringing your team along with you.

  • You care about impact, not noise: You care deeply about the substance of your work. You measure success by results, not recognition, and you let your work speak for itself. 

  • You’re energized by complexity and ambiguity: You enjoy tackling problems that don’t come with a playbook. You’re comfortable building from scratch, iterating as you go, and collaborating to shape the best path forward.

  • You seek out feedback: You see directness as respect, not criticism. You actively seek input, sit with hard truths, and use feedback as fuel for improvement.

  • Small businesses are why we're here: Relay exists to help them thrive -- and that mission has to resonate with you.

Join Us

We're looking for people who are relentless, curious, and care deeply about the work. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description -- your perspective and drive matter more. We welcome diverse backgrounds and people who think critically, challenge the status quo, and want to help small businesses thrive.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the hiring process, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

Disclaimer: For compliance reasons, all offers of employment at Relay are conditional upon a successful background check and employment verification through Certn.

Important Notice: Relay’s recruitment team only contacts candidates and corresponds from official corporate email addresses ending in @relayfi.com. We will never ask for sensitive personal data (such as bank account details, credit card numbers, or social security/insurance numbers) during the initial application or interview stages.
